picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant to build new supercomputing infrastructure is one of the largest single AI-research funding commitments of the year, dramatically expanding national scientific computing capacity.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the same Schmidt Science Computing Network establishes the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, pairing major funding with a strategic multi-institution computing partnership.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment funding 20 Turing AI Fellows is a substantial national-level bet on building UK AI research capability across multiple disciplines.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to regulators has direct implications for AI governance and national security policy worldwide.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloguing 95 concrete AI catastrophic-risk scenarios is a significant contribution to the AI safety policy conversation.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST represents a novel cross-border application of AI to environmental science with real conservation stakes.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project brings agentic AI into lattice QCD calculations, a genuine scientific advance in using AI to accelerate fundamental particle physics research.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College spinout Cogitat for its brain-signal foundation model shows real commercial validation of university-born neurotechnology AI research.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA's finding that materials-science AI models need far less training data than assumed could meaningfully lower the cost and barrier to AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals demonstrated autonomous systems successfully performing disaster-response triage, a concrete real-world test of AI in life-safety applications.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event
